pages.title: Hulls and Pressure
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- A ship is only as strong as its **weakest block**. Past its limit a block floods the room, or far deeper implodes the ship.
- Glass and wooden hatches give way first: use **pressurized glass**.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A dry interior needs a sealed hull, an **Electrolyzer** and an **Oxygen Diffuser**.

Deep water crushes blocks. Every block has a **maximum depth**, and a ship is only as strong as its **weakest block**. The **Pressure Barometer** compares the pressure on the ship to what the weakest block can take. [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show a block's hull tier: fragile, standard or reinforced.

pages.title: Rated depths
pages.text:
Each block has a rated depth, which the shape of the hull scales up or down:

- Plain glass: 28 m
- Oak planks: 44 m
- Wooden trapdoors and doors: 49 m
- Copper trapdoors and doors: 85 m
- Iron trapdoors and doors: 99 m
- Iron block: 101 m

Past its limit a block gives way. Above a certain depth the room just floods through the hole.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** far deeper, a failing block implodes the whole ship. The **Industrial Alarm** flashes and sounds faster every 5 m you sink past the safe depth.\
\
Tune it all in the Deep Seas [#](7A3C9A)[config](entry://glossary/config)[#]().

pages.title: Pressure Barometer
pages.text: Shows depth and pressure. Attach a [#](2E5AAC)[Display Link](entry://create_basics/redstone_and_control)[#]() to broadcast depth and hull state to a Display Board.

pages.title: Iron Pressurized Glass
pages.text: **Windows need special glass.** Glass, Iron and Copper Pressurized Glass resist pressure; plain glass does not.

A dry interior needs a sealed hull.

- An **Electrolyzer** turns water into oxygen.
- An **Oxygen Diffuser** spreads it through the ship (give it a redstone signal).

The Electrolyzer runs on FE power, see [#](2E5AAC)[Electricity](entry://industry/electricity)[#](), or you can put a Shaft in its module slot and spin it directly.

pages.title: Electrolyzer
pages.text: Water in, oxygen out. Accepts FE, or a shaft in the module slot for plain Create rotation.

To leave the ship underwater, build an airlock from two **Decompression Chambers** joined by [#](2E5AAC)[pipes and a pump](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]().\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** flood the airlock before opening the outer door deep down, or the sea crushes it in.\
\
Turn the pump round with a Wrench to dry it again.

pages.title: Decompression Chamber
pages.text: An airlock valve. Pipe water in at the back to flood a room, or out to empty it.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Hull limits can be tuned. Deep Seas has a max depth multiplier that scales every block, and per-block depths are stored in **config/submarine\_hull.json**. Windows and wooden hatches are the usual weak points, so use pressurized glass and iron hatches. Goggles on a block show its tier.

**Create: Deep Seas, Lava Fix** patches a bug: players inside a sealed submarine submerged in lava no longer take fire or lava damage, since the interior is dry. Nothing to set up.\
\
